#!/usr/bin/env python3
import os, re, json

d = json.load(open("/tmp/reach.json"))
paths = d["paths"]; unrooted = d["unrooted"]

DECL = re.compile(r'^(?:@\[[^\]]*\]\s*)?(?:private\s+|protected\s+|noncomputable\s+|partial\s+|unsafe\s+)*'
                  r'(theorem|lemma|def|abbrev|structure|class|instance|inductive)\s+([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_\'\.!?]*)')

out = {}
for m in unrooted:
    p = paths[m]
    ns = []
    names = []
    with open(p, encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for i, line in enumerate(f, 1):
            nm = re.match(r'^namespace\s+([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_\'\.]*)', line)
            if nm: ns.append(nm.group(1)); continue
            if re.match(r'^end\s', line) and ns:
                en = line.split()[1] if len(line.split())>1 else None
                if en and ns and ns[-1]==en: ns.pop()
                continue
            mm = DECL.match(line)
            if mm:
                names.append((mm.group(2), i, ".".join(ns)))
    out[m] = names

json.dump(out, open("/tmp/decls.json","w"), indent=1)
tot = sum(len(v) for v in out.values())
print("modules:", len(out), "decls:", tot)
# write flat list of bare names
with open("/tmp/decl_names.txt","w") as f:
    for m, v in out.items():
        for (n,i,ns) in v:

      [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsRegularLocalRing R],
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R).spanFinrank = n →

        RingTheory.Sequence.IsRegular R rs by
    exact haux _ R rfl
  intro n

    -- Base case `dim 0`: spanFinrank = 0, hence `maximalIdeal R = ⊥` (so `R` is

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Scan hgraph nodes for file: pointing into unrooted modules."""
import os, re, json, collections

P = "/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild"
d = json.load(open("/tmp/reach.json"))
unrooted = set(d["unrooted"])
# map file path (relative, as hgraph writes it) -> module
unrooted_files = {}
for m in unrooted:
    unrooted_files["AlgebraicJacobian/" + "/".join(m.split(".")[1:]) + ".lean"] = m

res = collections.defaultdict(list)
nodedir = os.path.join(P, "hgraph", "nodes")
n_total = 0
for fn in os.listdir(nodedir):
    if not fn.endswith(".md"): continue
    p = os.path.join(nodedir, fn)
    with open(p, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
        txt = f.read()
    n_total += 1
    mfile = re.search(r'^file:\s*(\S+)\s*$', txt, re.M)
    if not mfile: continue
    fpath = mfile.group(1)
    if fpath in unrooted_files:
        mod = unrooted_files[fpath]
        decl = re.search(r'^decl:\s*(\S+)\s*$', txt, re.M)
        status = re.search(r'^lean_status:\s*(\S+)\s*$', txt, re.M)
        title = re.search(r'^title:\s*(.*)$', txt, re.M)
        res[mod].append((fn, decl.group(1) if decl else None,
                         status.group(1) if status else None,
                         title.group(1).strip() if title else None))

print("hgraph nodes total:", n_total)
tot = sum(len(v) for v in res.values())
print("hgraph nodes whose file: is an UNROOTED module:", tot, "across", len(res), "modules")
sc = collections.Counter(s for v in res.values() for (_,_,s,_) in v)
print("their lean_status:", dict(sc))
json.dump({k: v for k,v in res.items()}, open("/tmp/hgraph_unrooted.json","w"), indent=1)
for m in sorted(res):
    print(f"{len(res[m]):4d}  {m.replace('AlgebraicJacobian.','')}")
